commenti.body: Idk about it being that lazy. A group of idiots banded together wanting to do harm can still be dangerous. Look at Deliverance or Mississippi Burning. Just because they have some backwards ass ways of thinking doesn’t mean they can’t have plans to hurt and destroy.

So your measure of aptitude is whether they could overthrow the US government? Seems like a high bar. Just cuz they couldnt successfully pull off a coup doesnt mean they arent dangerous or capable of violence. And hell, theyve now become darlings of a huge chunk of gop house reps who treat them like fucking martyrs for their failed coup attempts so maybe they are more successful than we care tonadmit.

I don't think the Becky movies are intended to be profound or deep or anything. They come across as campy modern exploitation films with comedic actors playing against type. Personally, I love it. I'm a horror junkie and these movies have some great kills. However, they're not fine art. They're as corny as it gets but that's part of the fun. I'm curious to see what B-level actor they get for the 3rd installment. Maybe Rob Schneider as the evil mastermind?

It must be nice not to see neo-Nazis and the government’s coddling of them as worrying. Anyway, I didn’t find this film as good as the first, but not because they went heavier with the neo-Nazi theme.
